title: Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center CommandSinkRmi Deserialization of Untrusted Data Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
description:
This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.
The specific flaw exists within the CommandSinkRmi class. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in deserialization of untrusted data. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the www user.
addtionnal_details:
Cisco has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at:
https://sec.cloudapps.cisco.com/security/center/content/CiscoSecurityAdvisory/cisco-sa-fmc-javarce-y2NypXwk
